def sort_dict_by_value(d):
    items = []
    for key, value in d.items(): # 1
        items.append((key, value))

    n = len(items)
    for i in range(n): # 2
        for j in range(0, n - i - 1): # 3
            if items[j][1] > items[j + 1][1]:
                items[j], items[j + 1] = items[j + 1], items[j]

    sorted_result = []
    for k in range(len(items)): # 4

    temp_dict = {}

        temp_dict[key] = value

    final_list = []

                final_list[jdx], final_list[jdx + 1] = final_list[jdx + 1], final_list[jdx]

    return final_list

def is_valid_isbn10(isbn):
    if len(isbn) != 10:
        return False

    checksum = 0
    for i in range(9):
        char = isbn[i]
        if not '0' <= char <= '9':
            return False
        checksum += int(char) * (i + 1)

    last_char = isbn[9]
    if '0' <= last_char <= '9':
        checksum += int(last_char) * 10
    elif last_char == 'X':
        checksum += 10 * 10
    else:
        return False

    return checksum % 11 == 0
